name: pets
description: An animal (dog, cat, turtle, duck, penguin or the Claude mascot) roams an isometric world (8 map sets) in a docked terminal panel and reacts to session signals (prompts, tool calls, turn ends).

language.title: Language
language.description: Panel and command language: auto, en or ko. auto follows the language key in settings, then LC_ALL and LANG, then English
